claims.title: Budget holds, overruns are recorded
claims.invariant: Committed plus reserved spend never exceeds the budget. If an actual cost exceeds its authorization, the full cost is recorded, the overrun is visible, and further spend is denied.

claims.title: Policy and approval can’t be bypassed
claims.invariant: A denied operation never runs. An approval-required operation runs only after a fresh human approval that matches its operation and amount.

claims.title: No impersonating another agent
claims.invariant: Agent and session identity and authority come from the trusted runtime, never from fields the agent supplies.

claims.title: Gongbu credentials stay out of reach
claims.invariant: Credentials held by Gongbu cannot be read by the agent or used except through a Hubu-authorized call.

claims.title: Agent can’t change its own governance
claims.invariant: Policies, budgets, approvals and ledger history change only through the owner path. The agent can’t raise its limits, approve itself, rewrite history, or misrepresent a pending approval.

claims.title: Provider packs can’t widen authority
claims.invariant: A pack can’t misprice spend below verified rates, send a credential to a host it isn’t bound to, or become active without the owner.
